| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-servants bound-them and-cast-them into-the-furnace-of fire burning. |
| LOGOS | The servants bound them and threw them into the burning fiery furnace. |

## 3:27 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-the-satraps, the-prefects, the-governors, and-the-king's-counselors gathered-together and-saw these men — the-fire had-no power over their-bodies, and-the-hair-of their-head was-not-singed, and-their-cloaks were-not-changed, and-the-smell-of fire had-not-come upon-them. |
| LOGOS | And the satraps, the prefects, the governors, and the king's counselors gathered together and saw that the fire had not had any power over the bodies of those men. The hair of their heads was not singed, their cloaks were not harmed, and no smell of fire had come upon them. |
| PNEUMA | Then the highest officials of the kingdom crowded around them and saw that the fire had not touched them. Not a hair on their heads was singed, their robes were not scorched, and they didn't even smell like smoke! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

| LOGOS | The herald proclaimed loudly, 'You are commanded, O peoples, nations, and languages, that when you hear the sound of the horn, pipe, lyre — you are to fall down and worship the golden image.' |
| PNEUMA | A herald shouted, 'People of all races, nations, and languages — when you hear the music, you must fall down and worship the gold statue!' |
